title: Simple Manhunt
body:
This mod is an easy to use, lightweight minecraft manhunt tool.

Start the game with /manhunt start <hunter> <runner>. **To specify multiple hunters, type /manhunt start @a[name=!<runner>] <runner>** (Replace <runner> with their player name)

This mod does not have a player tracking compass, instead run /where and it will tell the hunters what the runner's X and Y coordinates are. **After running /where, there will be a 1 minute cooldown.**
